Requirement1_text: The system shall prevent any appointments made less than 24 hours.
Requirement2_text: The system shall stop sending notifcations for appointments made less than 24 hours

Requirement1_text: The system shall not accept property posting without images.
Requirement2_text: MLS property posts without images shall be removed after 30 days.

Requirement1_text: The buyer shall be able to view all MLS listings
Requirement2_text: The buyer agent shall make only MLS listing that match the buyers criteria visible to the buyer.

Requirement1_text: The agent shall be able to lookup and update any property listings in the MLS
Requirement2_text: The administrator shall create an access right for the agent that would allow the agent only view the MLS listings that are in his or her zone

Requirement1_text: The system shall generate all the MLS  numbers based on three criterias date, zone, and zip code.
Requirement2_text: Relisting a previously sold house can reuse the same MLS number.

Requirement1_text: The system shall allow a buyer remove MLS listing from his or her listing set.
Requirement2_text: The buyer has only view right to all MLS listing and cannot modify the listings in his or her set.

Requirement1_text: Buyer shall be able to generate a Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) report based on property criteria
Requirement2_text: Only realators shall have access to CMA analysis and report generation

Requirement1_text: The system shall update all MLS listing properties once a day.
Requirement2_text: The system shall update all MLS listing properties at midnight each Saturday.

Requirement1_text: The system shall retrieve new raw data for  Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) everytime a new house is sold in a given area
Requirement2_text: The system shall retrieve the raw data for Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) once a week.

Requirement1_text: Only the seller agent shall be able to marked an under contract MLS listing as sold.
Requirement2_text: The system automatically change the status of under contract listing as sold once the case is closed.

Requirement1_text: The agent shally be able to add new clients to the systems using their client ID
Requirement2_text: The agent shally not be able to add new clients to the systems using their client ID
